name: Mailgun
description: Transactional email delivery, domain configuration, events, analytics, and account administration through Mailgun's HTTP API.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Mailgun key once, select capabilities, and let agents inspect delivery state, send mail, or use the full supported Mailgun API under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: MAILGUN_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Mailgun API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use your own account/RBAC key, or a Domain Sending Key for send-only access.

credentialRequirements.name: MAILGUN_DOMAIN
credentialRequirements.label: Mailgun domain
credentialRequirements.helpText: The verified Mailgun domain this connection is allowed to use.

credentialRequirements.name: MAILGUN_REGION
credentialRequirements.label: Mailgun region
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter US or EU to match the region that owns the domain.

credentialRequirements.name: MAILGUN_KEY_TYPE
credentialRequirements.label: Key type
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter account for account/RBAC keys or domain_sending for a Domain Sending Key.

capabilities.label: Domain status
capabilities.description: Inspect the bound domain, DNS verification, and sending state.

capabilities.label: Events and logs
capabilities.description: Read bounded delivery events and logs for the bound domain.

capabilities.label: Send messages
capabilities.description: Send messages through the bound and provider-authorized domain.

capabilities.label: Full Mailgun API
capabilities.description: Use the provider-supported Mailgun HTTP API within the configured account, domain, and region.

allowed.label: Read domain
allowed.description: Inspect the bound domain and verification state.

allowed.label: Read events
allowed.description: Read bounded delivery events for the bound domain.

approvalRequired.label: Send message
approvalRequired.description: Sending email requires approval in Safe mode.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Mailgun API
approvalRequired.description: All other Mailgun API operations require approval in Safe mode.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly; sends and all other API operations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The agent may use every selected Mailgun capability without Relay per-action approvals; provider authority, connection ownership, secret isolation, audit evidence, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts bounded Mailgun tools and proxies credentials server-side.
Railway mounts bounded Mailgun tools and proxies credentials server-side.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer enters their own Mailgun key, bound domain, region, and key type in Relay Console.

evidence.supports: Mailgun uses HTTP Basic Auth with username api and customer-owned API keys; primary account keys can use all API endpoints while Domain Sending Keys are send-only.
Mailgun publishes distinct fixed US and EU API origins and rate-limit response headers.
The official Mailgun API reference covers messages, domains, events/logs, metrics, templates, suppressions, mailing lists, routes, webhooks, keys, credentials, and domain administration.
